answers.explanation: The Geography master argues that the Almighty God is punishing Africans for sins committed long ago.
The master's arguments contrast Africa and Britain, so he did not argue that malaria exists in Britain.
Rock the boat describes an action that upsets things, a metaphor.
The new boy argued that many white men prefer the African climate to their own.
The master's anger suggests he knew the boy's points were valid.
The clause who had no answer to this new battle describes the boy and is a non-defining relative clause.
